title: VisionEvent
description: Standard schema for real-time computer vision inference events emitted by ai_vision module.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of frame capture and analysis.

face_detected.description: True if a primary driver face was detected in the frame.

eye_closure_duration_ms.description: Continuous duration in milliseconds for which eyes have remained closed.

yawn_detected.description: True if mouth aspect ratio (MAR) indicates sustained yawning.

head_nod_detected.description: True if head pose pitch estimation indicates a drowsy nodding motion.

tracking_reliable.description: True if lighting and facial landmark confidence exceed minimum reliability threshold.

ear_score.description: Optional Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR) metric for telemetry/diagnostics.

mar_score.description: Optional Mouth Aspect Ratio (MAR) metric for telemetry/diagnostics.
